field_contracts.document_rag_evidence_projection: document RAG retrieved chunks and answer citations project into claim records, source annotations, normalized citation refs, and projection assertions
field_contracts.claim_records: claim records include claim_id, claim_kind, required_evidence_kinds, source_refs, citation_refs, and allow_missing_evidence
field_contracts.source_annotations: source annotations include source_id, kind, locator, observed_at, retrieved_at, evidence_hash, and provider_free
field_contracts.citation_refs: citation refs must resolve to source annotations or appear in unresolved_refs
field_contracts.requirement_matrix: requirement rows define minimum refs, allowed evidence kinds, required fields, and clean degradation modes
field_contracts.citation_normalization: normalization lowercases ids, strips query fragments, dedupes repeated refs, and preserves first-seen order
field_contracts.freshness_policy: freshness rules compare fixture timestamps and emit warning refs without network calls
field_contracts.clean_degradation: unsupported or unresolved claims are omitted or degraded with deterministic warnings instead of invented evidence

acceptance_gates: all checked refs either resolve to source annotations or appear in unresolved_refs
document RAG answer citations resolve to source chunks before becoming evidence claims
claims with insufficient required evidence produce clean_degradation_actions
freshness warnings name stale source refs and do not block unless policy says so
normalized citations preserve deterministic first-seen order
fixtures remain provider-free, credential-free, live-network-free, and model-call-free
